name: Hearthbloom Basin
core_rationale: Formed inside Sola the Hearth-Weaver's fallen ceramic shield (scar-kiln-basin), serving as the warm, low-hazard Level 1 to 15 starter continent where Star-Kindled Sprouts first awaken.

parent_world_history_causes.causal_summary: Sola's eternal ember-heart beneath the clay soil keeps the basin at perpetual spring and powers the town hearths.

climate_profile.macro_biome: Sun-baked terracotta terraces, short clover meadows, and warm thermal creeks
weather_phenomena: Gentle ember-pollen drift across warm afternoon breezes
climate_profile.skybox_palette: Golden-hour apricot sky with soft cumulus clouds

civilization_style.architecture_motif: Glazed teapot-domed cottages, brick archways, and waterwheel bakeries
civilization_style.character_scale_adaptation: All cottages use 2.0 by 1.5 meter keyhole doorways, 0.14 meter step risers, 0.58 meter bakery counters, and clover grass capped at 0.25 meters so 1.05 meter Sprouts have unobstructed sightlines.

travel_links.unlock_rationale: Repaired upon completing the Level 15 Hearthbloom main story chapter.
Opened after igniting the Crown Beacon Citadel star-lighthouse in The Zenith Crown on Continent 03.

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin from world-history-cradle-of-embers and hosts the bound Starter Town town-lantern-hollow.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Glazed teapot-domed villages and warm terracotta caldera terraces powered by a slumbering Goddess's ceramic shield.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Enforces 2.0x1.5m keyhole doorways, 0.14m stair risers, 0.58m shop counters, and 0.25m clover grass for 0.90 to 1.20 meter characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Spans Levels 1 to 18 across Teacup Meadows and Kilnfire Terraces (Canon) plus Ash-Bellows Trench (Draft), linking to both Continent 02 and Continent 03.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves Ash-Bellows Trench in Draft status with Mystery child Firebrick Duct while completing the 3-continent airship loop.
